name: app-no-root
description: NDS runtime sits in wwwroot/assets (all eight bundles, banner 1.7.1); no NDS_ROOT reference folder on disk, no NDS-PLAN.md. The anchor's NDS_ROOT path declaration points at .nds/, which does not exist.
source: hand-authored 2026-08-20 from the mini-app fixture; bundle stubs carry the real release banner block with the version swapped, bodies inert
leakAudited: 2026-08-20 (clean — description and seeds carry world-state only; variant/postAssemble notes are harness-side, never shown to a runner)
postAssemble: rm -rf <out>/.nds  — assemble.mjs always writes an NDS_ROOT; this state is defined by its absence, and an overlay can only add files.

variants.banner-mismatch: cp -r <state>/variants/banner-mismatch/* <out>/  — replaces wwwroot/assets/css/nds-main.min.css with a 1.7.0-bannered copy, so the CSS bundle and the JS bundle report different versions.

releases.note: Seeded stand-ins for the GitHub release artifacts. The rig serves <state>/releases/ as the download source (static server or a copy step); the folder layout mirrors the URL paths the rules file uses, so releases/download/v<v>/... and releases/archive/refs/tags/v<v>.zip resolve as relative paths. No network in this rig.
releases.shape: Template zips wrap everything in nds-vanilla-template-v<v>/ and ship no _source/. Source zips wrap everything in NDS-vanilla-<v>/ and carry repo-root folders plus repo-root files. Every file inside is a skeletal stub of a few lines.
